interpretation: P4H's stationary two-cumulant approximation preserves simple step position and contrast but does not generalize to all high-frequency or sparse nonstationary density fields.
The smallest checkerboard overshoots reference contrast by up to 23.19%, and region variance can collapse to 0.2297 of the area-resolved reference.
A single stationary coarse profile is therefore insufficient. The retained P4H result is limited to locally stationary fields and cannot open photographic rendering.
A successor may use an explicit density-heterogeneity gate to fall back to exact base-pitch area resolution, but it must measure fallback coverage, seams, determinism and the unchanged P4I gates.
